desc:
Nearly eight years after the fall of King Noob, another ruler of the noobs has risen from seemingly nowhere. You need to find them and stop their noob takeover! The future of Roblox is at stake, will you be the hero that Roblox needs?

You want to play with your friends? You can do that. You want boss fights? We've got boss fights. You want badges? We've got badges. You want multiple endings? Guess what, we've got that covered too. In fact, the only thing we don't cover is car insurance.
